title: data/listening.json
description: Scrobbles per week over the whole Last.fm account, for the listening calendar and its figures on music.html (js/listening.js). Written weekly by .github/scripts/refresh_listening.py from Last.fm's weekly artist charts: a week on file is kept, and a run asks only for the weeks it does not have and the newest two. With no weeks in it the page shows no calendar.

user.description: The Last.fm account the charts belong to.

registered.description: The day the account opened, YYYY-MM-DD, from user.getinfo on the first run. No week that ended before it is asked for. Absent until that run.

updated.description: Date of the refresh that last wrote the file, YYYY-MM-DD. Absent until the first one.

weeks.description: One record per Last.fm chart week, oldest first. A week the script could not fetch has no record and is asked for again on the next run; a week with nothing played has one, with n at 0.

d.description: The day the chart week starts, YYYY-MM-DD in UTC. Last.fm's weeks run from noon on a Sunday; the calendar files each under the ISO week most of it falls in.

n.description: Scrobbles that week: the plays of every artist in the week's chart, added up.

a.description: The week's most played artist. Left out of a week with nothing played.

p.description: That artist's plays that week. Present whenever a is.
